name: Book

fields.name: isbn
fields.description: International Standard Book Number - unique identifier for the book

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the book

fields.name: author
fields.description: Primary author or authors of the book

fields.name: category
fields.description: Genre or classification category (e.g., Fiction, Science, History)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current availability status: available, checked_out, or reserved

fields.name: publicationYear
fields.description: Year the book was published

fields.name: copiesTotal
fields.description: Total number of copies owned by the library

fields.name: copiesAvailable
fields.description: Number of copies currently available for checkout

validation.copiesAvailable: Must be less than or equal to copiesTotal

description: Represents books in the library collection with catalog information and availability tracking

name: Member

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Unique membership identification number

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the library member

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for communication and notifications

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Contact phone number

fields.name: membershipStartDate
fields.description: Date when membership was activated

fields.name: membershipExpiryDate
fields.description: Date when membership expires

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if member account is currently active and eligible for borrowing

description: Represents library patrons with personal details, membership ID, contact information, and account status

name: Reservation

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the reservation

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the reserved book

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who made the reservation

fields.name: reservationDate
fields.description: Date and time when the reservation was made

fields.name: queuePosition
fields.description: Position in the reservation queue for this book

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the reservation (pending, notified, fulfilled, cancelled, expired)

fields.name: notifiedDate
fields.description: Date when member was notified that the book is available

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when the reservation expires if not fulfilled

indexes.description: Optimize queue position lookups for a specific book
Efficiently find expired reservations for cleanup

constraints.validStatus: Status must be one of: pending, notified, fulfilled, cancelled, expired
constraints.positiveQueuePosition: Queue position must be a positive integer
constraints.uniqueActiveReservation: A member can only have one active reservation per book

description: Manages book reservations when items are currently unavailable, tracking the queue and notification status

relationships.description: Each reservation is for one book
Each reservation belongs to one member

name: Transaction

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the transaction

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Reference to the member who borrowed the book

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: Reference to the book being borrowed

fields.name: checkoutDate
fields.description: Date when the book was checked out

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date when the book is due for return

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Actual date when the book was returned (null if not yet returned)

fields.name: lateFee
fields.description: Late fee amount charged for overdue returns

indexes.description: Fast lookup of transactions by member
Fast lookup of transactions by book
Quick identification of active checkouts (null returnDate)

constraints.lateFeeNonNegative: lateFee must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.returnDateAfterCheckout: returnDate must be after or equal to checkoutDate when set

description: Records book checkout and return activities with dates and fees for library circulation tracking

relationships.description: Each transaction belongs to one member
